news.headline: Lexeo Therapeutics (NASDAQ:LXEO) Raised to "Strong-Buy" at Chardan Capital
news.summary: Chardan Capital upgraded LXEO from Buy to Strong-Buy, extending a wave of bullish sell-side notes that followed the company's mid-June regulatory update and JAMA Cardiology publication on LX2006.

news.headline: Oppenheimer initiates Lexeo Therapeutics stock with Outperform rating
news.summary: Oppenheimer began coverage of Lexeo with an Outperform rating and a $20 price target, citing over $1 billion in potential peak U.S. sales for LX2006 and further upside from the LX2020 PKP2 cardiomyopathy program.

news.headline: JPMorgan Cuts Lexeo Therapeutics Price Target to $9 from $12, Maintains Overweight
news.summary: JPMorgan trimmed its LXEO price target to $9 from $12 while reiterating an Overweight rating, citing an updated valuation model following recent pipeline developments and a split analyst picture on the stock.

news.headline: H.C. Wainwright Raises Lexeo Therapeutics Price Target to $15 from $9 on FDA Feedback
news.summary: H.C. Wainwright raised its LXEO price target and maintained a Buy rating after the FDA's written minutes confirmed openness to a pooled Phase 1/2 and pivotal dataset and acceptance of an earlier LVMI assessment for accelerated approval; the firm also raised its probability-of-approval estimate to 50% from 40%.

news.headline: Lexeo Therapeutics Announces Publication in JAMA Cardiology of Phase I/II Data for LX2006 in Friedreich Ataxia
news.summary: Peer-reviewed Phase I/II data on 17 Friedreich ataxia cardiomyopathy patients treated with LX2006 showed sustained cardiac and neurologic improvements, favorable biomarker changes, and a generally well-tolerated safety profile, reinforcing the clinical rationale behind the pivotal SUNRISE-FA2 program.

news.headline: Lexeo Therapeutics Announces Regulatory Update and Registrational Trial Design for LX2006 Gene Therapy in Friedreich Ataxia
news.summary: Lexeo finalized with the FDA the pivotal SUNRISE-FA2 trial protocol and statistical analysis plan for LX2006, confirmed it can use its optimized Sf9-baculovirus commercial-scale manufacturing process for dosing, and targeted a BLA submission under the accelerated approval pathway in H1 2028; enrollment of the first patient was expected by end of June 2026, and shares jumped nearly 13% on the news.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Lexeo is expected to report second-quarter 2026 financial results and pipeline updates in August 2026 (it reported Q2 2025 results on August 14, 2025); an exact 2026 date has not yet been formally announced as of early August 2026.

catalysts.label: LX2020 12-month high-dose data (HEROIC-PKP2)
catalysts.detail: Company guidance calls for a 12-month data update covering all high-dose PKP2-associated arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy participants in the ongoing HEROIC-PKP2 Phase I/II trial.

catalysts.label: SUNRISE-FA2 topline data readout
catalysts.detail: Topline data from the pivotal SUNRISE-FA2 trial of LX2006 in Friedreich ataxia cardiomyopathy is guided for the second half of 2027.

catalysts.label: LX2006 BLA submission
catalysts.detail: Lexeo plans to submit a Biologics License Application to the FDA for LX2006 under the accelerated approval pathway in the first half of 2028.

catalysts.label: First patient dosed in pivotal SUNRISE-FA2 trial
catalysts.detail: Following the June 2026 FDA-aligned trial design finalization, Lexeo guided to enrolling the first SUNRISE-FA2 pivotal-trial participant by the end of June 2026; a standalone confirmation of actual first dosing has not yet been separately announced as of early August 2026.

pulse: Lexeo remains a clinical-stage cardiovascular gene therapy company advancing two lead AAV programs, LX2006 for Friedreich ataxia cardiomyopathy and LX2020 for PKP2-related arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy, having finalized the FDA-aligned SUNRISE-FA2 pivotal trial design in mid-June 2026 (sending shares up nearly 13%) and followed that within days with supportive LX2006 data published in JAMA Cardiology and a price-target hike from H.C. Wainwright. Sell-side sentiment stayed mixed-to-bullish through late summer: JPMorgan trimmed its target to $9 in late June even as it kept an Overweight rating, while Oppenheimer initiated at Outperform ($20 target) and Chardan Capital upgraded to Strong-Buy, both on July 31, pointing to over $1 billion in potential peak U.S. sales for LX2006. With cash guided to last into 2028 (following a workforce reduction earlier in 2026), the next concrete catalysts are Q2 2026 earnings expected in August (date not yet announced), 12-month high-dose LX2020 data in Q4 2026, and SUNRISE-FA2 topline data in H2 2027 ahead of a planned 2028 BLA filing.
